title: Fed Rate Cuts Are Coming-Buy These 7 Stocks Before the Shift
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Brad Thomas of Wide Moat Research with seven REIT picks for 2026, arguing rate cuts under a new Fed chair make REITs - the worst-performing asset class of 2025 - a comeback story. Five 'sleep well at night' names: Realty Income (O) - net-lease giant with 15,500+ properties, A-rated balance sheet, 27 straight years of dividend growth, still a buy at 15.3x price-to-AFFO vs ~17x normal, 4.9% yield; Equinix (EQIX) - data-center landlord with 273 properties across 36 countries, a sticky interconnection moat, 10% dividend hike and 10.4% growth guidance, 'extremely cheap' at 24x AFFO with a 2.6% yield; Public Storage (PSA) - the self-storage leader with a fortress balance sheet and sticky business model, 19x vs ~22x normal multiple; Equity Lifestyle (ELS) - manufactured-housing/RV resorts riding the 'silver tsunami' of 10,000 baby boomers turning 65 daily, dividend raised 5.3% for 22 straight years; EastGroup (EGP) - Sunbelt warehouse flex space with 96.5% occupancy, 8.8% FFO growth, 27x vs ~30x normal, 3.3% yield. Two high-risk/high-reward names: Americold (COLD) - cold-storage REIT down ~35% in 2025 with an activist stake and new CEO, trading at 8.9x vs 25.7x normal with a 7.4% yield; Healthpeak (DOC) - medical offices plus life science, spinning off senior housing into Janus Living, 8.9x vs ~45x for Welltower, 7.3% yield, though life-science occupancy fell 390bp. No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: 'America'/'Maricole' = Americold (COLD); 'Equinex' = Equinix (EQIX); 'Eastg Groupoup' = EastGroup (EGP).
